Trust.description: ⚙ Engine-attached provenance of one datum. The model never writes this.

cmp.description: The quote's own hedging: ">$1B" → gt, "~20%" → approx.

basis.description: reported = the number is in the quote; derived = computed (cite every input); estimate = the run's judgement, drawn hatched.
